description:
One prompt. That's all it took to build a Vox-style animated chart with Claude Code and Remotion. No After Effects, no keyframes, and every chart runs on real cited data.

🎁 FREE PRACTICE KIT (prompts + assets + guide): https://www.skool.com/ai-visual-production-lab-4976

In this video I build all three charts with three prompts, break down the layers that make the "printed paper" look, and show you the one trick everyone gets wrong on hand-drawn animations. 

00:00 - 00:20 Intro
00:20 - 02:20 Chart 1: The Bar Chart
02:20 - 03:42 Chart 2: The Parliament
03:42 - 05:00 Chart 3: The One Clients Pay For
05:00 - 05:20 Outro
